name: kotaemon
test_cmd: cd libs/kotaemon && mkdir -p "$ENV/home" "$ENV/tmp" && unset OPENAI_API_KEY OPENAI_BASE_URL ANTHROPIC_API_KEY && HOME="$ENV/home" TMPDIR="$ENV/tmp" TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR="$ENV/tiktoken" THEFLOW_TEMP_PATH="$ENV/tmp/theflow" $PY -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -o log_file="$ENV/tmp/pytest-logs.txt" --deselect tests/test_vectorstore.py::TestMilvusVectorStore --deselect tests/test_agent.py::test_rewoo_agent --deselect tests/test_embedding_models.py::test_fastembed_embeddings; rc=$?; rm -rf ./"<MagicMock "*; exit $rc
notes: Python 3.11.17 (CI matrix is 3.10/3.11; requires-python >=3.10). uv 0.13.0. Setup mirrors CI's `uv sync --frozen` from the repo's uv.lock (uv workspace: root kotaemon-app + libs/kotaemon + libs/ktem, all installed editable from $SRC by setuptools finder .pth files, plus the dev group with pytest 8.4.2), into $ENV via UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT; --exclude-newer is passed but the frozen lock already pins everything (openai 1.109.1, langchain-openai 0.1.25, langchain-anthropic 0.1.23). Because the editables are setuptools finder hooks with hardcoded paths, `reinstall` re-runs `uv pip install --no-deps -e $SRC/libs/kotaemon -e $SRC/libs/ktem` to repoint them at a working copy. test_cmd = CI's `cd libs/kotaemon && pytest` (pytest.ini: testpaths=tests, -ra -q). Sandboxing: HOME/TMPDIR in $ENV; THEFLOW_TEMP_PATH (CI sets ./tmp) and pytest's log_file are redirected into $ENV/tmp so the repo copy stays clean; tests leave stray `<MagicMock name='create' id=...>/` directories in libs/kotaemon, so test_cmd removes them afterwards while preserving pytest's exit code. Offline: tiktoken's cl100k_base BPE (needed by many splitter/agent tests) is downloaded during setup into $ENV/tiktoken and TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR points there. Deselected (7): tests/test_vectorstore.py::TestMilvusVectorStore (5 tests; milvus-lite's unix socket path under $ENV/tmp exceeds macOS's 104-char sun_path limit; they pass with TMPDIR=/tmp), tests/test_agent.py::test_rewoo_agent (WikipediaTool is not mocked, hits wikipedia.org; fails offline), tests/test_embedding_models.py::test_fastembed_embeddings (downloads the qdrant/bge-small ONNX model from Hugging Face). 20 skips are the repo's own (paddleocr/unstructured/haystack not installed, 3 'OpenAI LC wrapper test is skipped'). All OpenAI/Azure/LangChain LLM tests patch openai.resources.*.create; no API key needed. libs/ktem/ktem_tests are not run by CI and are not included. Baseline taken with outbound network denied (macOS sandbox-exec, loopback/unix sockets allowed) and RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY unset, after rebuilding $ENV from scratch with the setup commands: two runs gave identical counts (109 passed, 20 skipped, 0 failed; 48.5s and 19.3s wall, first run includes .pyc compilation).
